install_startup.recipe_modification_note: Two real fixes were needed, both left in the recipe: (1) mysql:8.0 is explicitly rejected by Mautic's own installer ('Your database version (8.0.46) is too old for Mautic to work correctly. Supported versions are MySQL 8.4.0 (or higher) and MariaDB 10.11.0 (or higher)') - switched the db service to mysql:8.4. (2) The generic screen crawler's default form-filler blindly overwrites every detected input with placeholder text, including a pre-filled, valid numeric Database Port field on Mautic's own installer - this broke the DB-setup step ('The port must be an integer greater than 0'). Rather than patch the shared crawler under time pressure, the installer wizard (DB connection step, then admin-user creation step) was driven directly with a one-off Playwright script using the real field IDs (install_doctrine_step_host/port/name/user/password, then install_user_step_username/password/firstname/lastname/email), which completed cleanly through /installer/final to a real login screen. The admin account was then reset via Mautic's own Account Details page (/s/account) to the pipeline's standard libwalker/Walker-Pass-2026! test credentials, so the standard screens.py crawler could log in and complete a full, unmodified 15/15 screen walkthrough on its own - no crawler code changes needed.
